The handle merges into the cup body with excessive thickness and no clear seam or joint line, suggesting a 'melting' or fusion artifact rather than a distinct attached part.
The red decorative elements lack sharp edges and appear slightly smeared or painted on without consistent depth or interaction with the glaze layer.
